units.title: Act: Add cn helper, components.json and shadcn Button
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Steps 1-3 done as written: the five runtime deps are in game/frontend/package.json and npm install exited 0; src/lib/utils.ts has cn (cn('px-2','px-4') returns 'px-4'); components.json is valid JSON with the specified values. Step 4 is not as written: after I wrote src/components/ui/button.tsx (cva, Slot/asChild, default/ghost/outline variants, sizes default/sm/icon), the file on disk was replaced by another writer with a simpler forwardRef Button (variant 'default'|'ghost', no Slot/asChild, no cva, no outline/size variants). I did not revert it, per the on-disk change rule. Adaptation: Button imports cn via the relative path '../../lib/utils' instead of '@/lib/utils' because no @/ alias exists in tsconfig or vite config. Also seen on disk and not mine: package.json adds lucide-react, motion and tailwind devDeps; styles.css, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js and GameLayout.tsx were modified or added; node_modules is tracked in git and npm install touched tracked files. Typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exits 0 with 0 errors. No tests written; the .ai-dlc unit file for UNIT-287 is not in this worktree, so I worked from the brief. Decision needed: restore the specified Button in button.tsx, or accept the replacement.
